description: This file defines the interface ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder and nested factory interfaces ResponseFactory and EventFactory for building responses and events related to the ModifyFeature command in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events related to ModifyFeature commands.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects such as modifications and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects that reflect changes made by the ModifyFeature command.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeatureResponse indicating a feature has been created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeatureResponse indicating a feature has been modified.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a error response indicating the feature was not accessible.

methods.name: featureNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates a error response indicating the feature was not modifiable.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a FeatureCreated event reflecting the feature creation.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a FeatureModified event reflecting the feature modification.
